patch.value: Discover exact native command and SDK contracts in one bounded call
Versioned native flags, output dimensions, backend operations and typed recovery schemas with explicit oracle slices and native-only evidence.

Every advertised operation has a real invocation or parity receipt; unsupported methods cannot appear available; one bounded discovery call replaces multi-command help reads; no Git or Node runtime; typed SDK and compact TOON/JSON CLI with remedies; read-only public-copy validation; exact-head npm/Bun release gates.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap checked against current pm 2026.11.4 contracts output, the pinned 2026.10.21 public SDK capability/flag contracts, pm-web contract-explorer.ts, native-adapter ABI and bounded read sessions. Upstream describes the host command/runtime surface; pm-web projects provider availability; the ABI grants transport operations; sessions bound results. None inventories the compiled native product. This feature will derive exact flags from the real Clap parser, declare only evidenced native operation slices, and report injected backends as unavailable unless explicitly supplied and validated. No import/export/sync, tracker mutation, journal, shared lease or status interpretation is added. Existing SDK readers/codecs and adapter validators remain authoritative. Unsupported native options and methods default to unavailable; the oracle version labels evidence, never inferred compatibility.

Initial targeted validation passes 8 tests: 5 schema/parser/backend/output units and 3 native integration tests, including every advertised command invoked on a genuine non-git tracker, 500 seeded randomized request/replay sequences comparing unchanged SDK-read item state, and 500 numeric-boundary fuzz cases. All 32 adapter grant subsets are checked without opening a transport. The read-only feature adds no imports/exports/sync, journaled plans, retry keys, status-role decisions or shared mutable state; those existing paths are unchanged. A round-trip regression caught list-specific TOON table projection, so discovery uses the native codec directly and both producers now round-trip the same typed response.

value.text: Fresh-head CI exposed a portability bug in the new artifact-isolation test harness: Windows passes a drive path to Node --import, which requires a file URL. The two successful-run fixtures exit before the Cargo shim, while the expected-failure fixtures mask that loader failure. Fixing the preload boundary with pathToFileURL, retaining child stderr for actionable diagnostics, and using a shim filename containing a URL fragment marker to reproduce the same defect on the local platform. Product Rust code is unchanged. Fresh stable Rust CI already passes 728 Linux, 715 macOS and 709 Windows tests; the macOS aggregate separately hit an existing fresh-origin-clone timeout, and GitHub refuses reruns while the workflow is active. This corrective test commit will receive fresh exact-head CI.
